agent_notes: The superscription is verse 1 in the Hebrew (KJV 6:0, unnumbered title). Hebrew numbering runs one ahead of the KJV through the whole psalm. 'Sheminith' is rendered 'the Eighth' in the literal layer, a transliteration kept in the dramatic one; whether it is an eight-stringed lyre, an octave, or a mode is unresolved, and I say so rather than choose.
